art_direction: 雾蓝底青色双眼，左浅右高，侧目带一点蔑视。
composition_variation: Convey mild disdain through an oblique, unhurried side-eye. The viewer-left opening is long and shallow, about thirty percent open; the right opening is sixty percent open and its center is six percent of canvas height higher. Both large pupils glance together toward viewer-left. Give the lower left lid a slightly lifted outer end while the fuller right eye has a thick relaxed upper arch. Preserve generous black pupil areas and thin matching cyan side bands. The feeling is quietly unimpressed, never angry.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Latest user chat image observed locally: a mildly disdainful asymmetric gaze in opaque hand-painted black and cyan eye shapes. Only a written description was transmitted. No chat attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. Earlier eyes-only constraint retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet for readable eye expression, coordinated same-color irises, matte curved brush shapes, comfortable pastel background, no added face features, text or watermark
